findingClass: a field_sources row names a field whose value on the parent row is NULL — a false claim that a source supplied a value which does not exist, so every audit reading field_sources reports the field as sourced and healthy while the page shows nothing
sourceTask: #654 (2026-09-16): two IPOs that were OPEN and UPCOMING got no NSE documents because their NSE symbol was missing, while field_sources said CHITTORGARH had supplied it; 650 rows across 14 fields on staging, 453 across 13 on prod
failThreshold: any field_sources row whose named field resolves to a column on its parent table (ipos / ipo_details) and whose value in that column IS NULL; generic over columns (read from information_schema) so a field a future scraper starts writing is covered without being added here; NULL only, never falsiness, because 0/false/'' are values a source genuinely supplied
unverifiableWhen: field_sources or a parent table is not readable — reported as UNVERIFIABLE with the error, never as a PASS. A field_name that matches no column on the parent table is reported as a NOTE rather than counted: that is a different defect (provenance for a field the table does not have, e.g. ipos.listingExchange) and folding it in would hide it inside this check's zero.
